profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, ticker COUR, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its site describes an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with content from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. The company describes Coursera Plus as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The site names programs in AI, data science, cybersecurity, and related fields, among them the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Essentials Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. The company describes these as job-aligned programs built with employers and universities, and points to roles in project management, UX design, data science, cybersecurity, analytics, AI, and business.

The company's record lists no lawsuits and no MCP servers. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001651562, and its law exposure is recorded in California with a count of 281.
